paragraphs: Rabbi Yannai Zeaira: his father-in-law, who was also his teacher, died. Rabbi Chama said he should become impure for him: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 3, and Nazir 6:1 as printed (the matching passage is 7:1).
